hero.title: Your travel companion to the heart of Brazil

what.title: A digital platform built to connect travelers with the essence of Brazil
what.p1: Our purpose is to connect people — travelers and tourists — with the deepest layer of Brazilian culture: its people, flavors, knowledge, places and heritage.
what.p2: A tool that supports the journey of exploring every possibility of our country, while creating in each locality the opportunity for social transformation.
what.p3: We were born from the cultural richness and abundance of our country with the goal of delivering broad social and cultural impact. Ataîru was conceived to become the digital infrastructure of Brazilian cultural and sustainable tourism.
what.quote: Brazilian cultural heritage is one of the country's most valuable assets.
